what_this_records: The CONTROL INVENTORY the production preflight enforces, plus the digests of the modules that enforce it. This is a SOURCE-PROVEN record. The EXECUTED preflight results are recorded separately in the evidence-only tail commit, because the preflight can only reach SIGNATURE-REQUIRED against the out-of-tree FINAL template that binds the package candidate commit — which does not exist yet when this record is written.

controls.control: V4 schema required; V3 and V2 activation records are REFUSED for execution
provider_executable_identity must be a real sha256, never a placeholder
no '<founder' / 'founder-fills' placeholder may survive into an activation
the SIGNED run manifest must exist and its FILE digest must equal the signed digest
evidence_commit_sha/tree must equal the exact current HEAD/tree
lrcq_base and provider_candidate bindings must equal the mechanically resolved values
reviewed_runtime_sha must be a real commit in this repository
the bound provider target must exist, be a non-symlink regular file, and re-hash to the bound digest (digest only — preflight NEVER executes the provider)
a binding defect can NEVER be masked by a pending founder act — bindings are cross-checked before the signature gate
with an EMPTY governed key authority the classified founder gate is KEY_ENROLLMENT
zero provider / builder / checker invocation is asserted structurally on every preflight path

committed_package_candidate.expected: NOT APPLICABLE. The committed material deliberately carries the freeze placeholder in evidence_commit_*, because a commit cannot embed its own hash. It is NOT a final-head capsule and PF-5 is NOT expected to pass against it.

procedural_final_head_capsule.artifact: B — the out-of-tree capsule generated by tools/terminal0/lrcq/final-head-capsule.mjs AFTER the final evidence-only tail exists
procedural_final_head_capsule.expected: SIGNATURE-REQUIRED with founder_gate KEY_ENROLLMENT, binding_defects [], invocations.providerSpawn 0 and zero_invocation true

pf5_is_not_weakened: PF-5 is unchanged. run-five-hour.mjs is byte-identical to the approved authority candidate; its digest is recorded in enforcing_modules above.
